summary: Mobile Tanya KN + Biaya + Full-Views verification at 390x800 across sales/manager/finance/admin plus desktop admin regression at 1920. All acceptance criteria pass. MobileSalesApp loads (mobile-sales-app), home shows [m-home-ask-kn] which opens the Tanya sub page (mobile-sub-tanya + tanya-kn-page class 'tanya-page compact'). All 5 tabs present in the correct order: tanya-tab-chat|reports|history|schedules|cost with chat as default. Chat streaming works on mobile: typing in [tanya-chat-input] + [tanya-chat-submit] shows [tanya-streaming] then [tanya-answer] with NO horizontal page overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth at 390px). Header actions wrap and tables live inside their own scroll container. Laporan → tapping [tanya-template-gallery] auto-switches back to chat tab and renders the answer. Riwayat → clicking a [tanya-session-<sid>] row switches to chat tab with the reopened thread (verified with tanya-session-aichat_73dffc95ca6d after seeding via a fresh submit). Jadwal tab renders. Biaya tab shows tanya-cost-page with tanya-budget-card, tanya-cost-kpi-total, chart-feature/user, tables, chips (range/scope/metric) — no horizontal overflow at 390px, demo notice ('Termasuk 225 baris data contoh…') readable. Full Views menu (mobile-more-full-views) contains all 9 items: sample-orders, rnd-samples, logistics, finance-cases, cash-advances, vehicle-logs, mkt-calendar, document-center, hr-my-profile. Each opens the responsive full page (no error boundary, body length 680–4503 chars) with a floating [mobile-back-to-app] button that returns to the mobile sales app. Deep link /?view=tanya-kn&entity=ent_ksc as sales on 390px correctly lands on the Tanya subpage inside mobile-sales-app. Manager+finance on mobile: MobileOpsApp shows mobile-tab-btn-tanya; the desktop switcher mo-open-desktop now lives inside the Ringkas tab mobile-tab-btn-kpi (verified click → open-desktop visible). Admin mobile shows exactly 6 tabs (queue, notif, matrix, kpi, catalog, tanya) with 0px tabbar horizontal overflow. Desktop regression at 1920 + kn_force_desktop=1 as admin → tanya-kn-page renders 2-column, chat tab absent, tabs Laporan/Riwayat/Jadwal/Biaya all present. history_opens_thread=False in first pass was a selector artifact (selector matched tanya-history-search input); re-run with [data-testid^='tanya-session-'] confirms it works.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileMore sub-page for Tanya KN uses a plain 'Kembali' arrow only; consider giving it a data-testid distinct from mobile-sub-back so both sub-pages (tanya vs other) can be targeted independently — already fine (mobile-sub-back reused).

Deep link /?view=tanya-kn on mobile currently lands only for sales (has MobileMore/tanya sub); for manager/finance the mobile Tanya lives on a top-level tab (mobile-tab-btn-tanya). A universal deep-link handler already routes correctly for sales — worth documenting that the initialTab effect (MobileShell) applies for ops mobile.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 40+ assertions pass across mobile sales/manager/finance/admin + desktop regression)

seed_data_creation: None. A test question 'penjualan minggu ini' was submitted as sales to populate history and re-verify session-open flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile Tanya KN (F6 mobile) verified. Reproduce quickly: set viewport 390x800 BEFORE login, clear localStorage.kn_force_desktop, login as sales, click [m-home-ask-kn]. Cost tab: [tanya-tab-cost] → [tanya-cost-page]. Full views: click [mobile-tab-btn-more] then any [mobile-full-<view>]; return with [mobile-back-to-app]. Manager/finance mobile Tanya: [mobile-tab-btn-tanya]. Admin has 6 tabs. Desktop admin: set localStorage.kn_force_desktop='1', viewport 1920, /?view=tanya-kn&entity=ent_ksc — chat tab is intentionally hidden on desktop (uses left-column composer instead).

native_mobile_screens: Lainnya: Tanya KN, Minta Harga Khusus, Kunjungan Sales, Status Stok, Prospek/Leads, Pelanggan/CRM, Retur, Pesanan Khusus (OD), Daftar Harga

products-pricing hub (Daftar Harga covers pricelist only)
stock-atp hub (only simple Status Stok exposed)
customers-crm hub sub-views (Pelanggan native covers list but not hub sub-pages)
Notifications center for sales (present on ops app, no separate button for sales — sales home shows bell icon)
sales_desktop_vs_mobile_audit.verdict: All 9 previously-desktop-only sales screens listed in FULL_VIEWS render OK on 390px with the floating back button. Broad hubs (sales-orders/customers-crm/products-pricing/stock-atp) are represented on mobile via the simpler native screens; consider adding hub-level full-views for parity if users need deeper drill-downs.

rca of the issue: No blocker bugs found. Initial false negative on history_opens_thread was caused by [data-testid^='tanya-history-'] matching the search input before the session card; corrected to [data-testid^='tanya-session-'] and confirmed session cards open threads and switch to chat tab. Mitigation: none needed for product; test regex tightened.
